work_lead: Seven case studies across robot learning, robotic hardware, product design, manufacturing and data — each with the decisions I made and the numbers behind them.
about: I'm a mechanical engineer finishing an M.Sc. in Mechatronics at UNIVPM, with a year of coursework at ULB and VUB in Brussels. I like problems where the hardware, the physics and the software have to be designed together.

Right now I'm working on robotic humanitarian demining at the Royal Military Academy: a reinforcement-learning policy, trained in MuJoCo, that decides which objects to remove — and how, and in what order — to extract a landmine safely from clutter. Next comes a UR5 arm and the transfer from simulation to the real robot.

experience.text: Robot learning for humanitarian demining: simulating cluttered scenes in MuJoCo and training reinforcement-learning policies, with the goal of transferring them to a real Universal Robots arm.

Maintenance of leather-goods machinery (Adler, ATOM, Galli, OMAC, among others), with experienced technicians or independently: sewing-machine hook timing, pneumatic troubleshooting, hydraulic seal replacement, replacement of faulty sensors and electronic control boards. Occasional technical support ongoing.

card.text: Designed and 3D-printed a custom fixture to position trouser labels during sewing — the most recent of several fixtures I made. Selected PLA and a high wall count to prioritize stiffness. The photograph shows the fixture installed on the sewing machine.

experience.text: Collision-free pick-and-place planning for the redundant 7-DOF arm of the TIAGo mobile manipulator (MATLAB): RRT parameter study and path shortcutting.
